title: Does it need that?
label: WHY DOES IT WANT YOUR CONTACTS?

beats.say: Why does a flashlight app want to see your contacts?
Apps ask for permissions all the time, and most people tap allow without reading.
A good rule is simple. If the permission does not match what the app does, say no.
You can review them anytime in settings, under privacy or app permissions.
Switch location to only while using the app, and turn off what you do not need.
Do a quick check tonight, and send this to someone with a hundred apps.
